title: a little disappointed
text: I didn't personally like the only 2 lip things in the kit, gloss. I am very disappointed that in the middle of summer there was no lip mosturizer in the bag at all. It had two make up products that are ok I guess.  I was expecting to get ALL lip stuff but that was not the case. I am going to give it one more month to impress me or I will cancell.
label: neutral
